summary: The note describes Khong Island, also called Don Khong, which is the largest island in the Si Phan Don riverine archipelago on the Mekong River. It is also the administrative seat of the area. The island lies in Khong District, Champasak Province, in southern Laos.
one_line: Khong Island (Don Khong) is the largest and administrative center of the Si Phan Don archipelago in the Mekong River, southern Laos.
key_facts: Khong Island is also known as Don Khong.
Khong Island is the largest island in the Si Phan Don riverine archipelago.
Khong Island is the seat of administration in the Si Phan Don archipelago.
The Si Phan Don archipelago is located in the Mekong River.
Khong Island is located in Khong District, Champasak Province.
Khong Island is located in southern Laos.
